# evroc_kms_key (Data Source)

Looks up a generated or externally imported KMS key in the provider region, including lifecycle state and version metadata. No key material is exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "evroc_kms_key" "application" {
  name = "application-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Key name, unique within the project and region.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project containing the key. Defaults to the provider project.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) Encryption algorithm reported by KMS.
- `auto_rotate_after_days` (Number) Automatic rotation interval in days; 0 when unset.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `enabled` (Boolean) True when the observed key state is Active.
- `expire_after_days` (Number) Key-version expiry interval in days; 0 when unset.
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified key identifier.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `imported` (Boolean) Whether the key uses externally imported material.
- `key_id` (String) System-assigned UUID.
- `region` (String) Region selected by the provider configuration.
- `state` (String) Observed KMS lifecycle state.
- `versions` (List of Object) Observed key versions; does not contain key material. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `expires_after` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `version` (Number)
